summary: Genmab A/S filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of its amended Articles of Association dated November 10, 2026, together with the cover report for the month of November 2026. The articles restate the DKK 62,570,683 share capital in DKK 1 shares, board authorizations through March 12, 2029 to raise up to nominally DKK 6,600,000 with and without pre-emption rights at not less than market value, and employee warrant programs. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or closing date is disclosed; this is an ordinary charter/corporate-governance filing with no special-situation event.
